mouse_gene_map.description: Common human→mouse gene symbol conversions for cross-species support
mouse_gene_map.note: Most mouse gene symbols are the same as human with first letter capitalized. Key exceptions listed here.
mouse_gene_map.rule: For most genes, capitalize first letter only (e.g., ALB→Alb, INS→Ins). The exceptions above follow standard mouse nomenclature.
